title: Macron condemns violence as French riots escalate

slides.headline: Macron condemns violence as French riots escalate
slides.subtitle: President Macron calls for accountability after government building attacks.

slides.explanation: The unrest has spread across multiple cities, leading to widespread property damage and significant police presence on the streets.

slides.headline: The focus is shifting toward legal accountability
slides.explanation: While the initial focus was on the street protests, the government is now specifically targeting those who attacked public buildings, promising they will face the law.
We verified this report across four independent news outlets. When sources like the BBC, Al Jazeera, France 24, and The Guardian agree, it confirms the core facts of the situation.

slides.subtitle: Read the full breakdown on Headlinne.

caption:
France is facing a difficult moment as protests over recent events turned into looting and attacks on government

infrastructure.

President Macron has been clear about his stance, stating that those responsible for damaging public property need to face consequences for their actions.

It is a complex situation that is drawing attention from around the world. We are watching the developments closely to see how the government responds and what steps are taken to restore order.
